evals.prompt: Set up a weekday 9 AM America/Los_Angeles watch through November 30 for this exact item. Alert me in this conversation only when its all-in USD price falls below 100, including the first qualifying observation. Do not buy it.
evals.context: Entirely synthetic initial state. The supplied offer is item widget-blue, quantity one, delivered to the supplied test location. A current source read shows USD 110 all-in, in stock, with retrieval timestamp November 2, 2026 at 16:00 UTC. An authorized private task store is available. The host exposes discoverable create/list scheduler operations supporting named zones, expiry, and conversation delivery; no matching watch or job exists. Fixture operations persist writes and permit independent readback. No job has been created, and no post-write result is supplied.
evals.expected_output: A bounded watch contract and baseline are saved, a real fixture scheduler job is configured and read back, and no threshold alert or purchase occurs at the baseline price.
assertions: Pins the item variant, quantity, currency, all-in basis, threshold direction, first-match rule, zone, cadence, destination, and expiry.
Establishes and validates the foreground baseline before creating a new scheduled job.
Uses the exposed scheduler instead of inventing infrastructure, then independently reads its stored configuration.
Reports job configuration separately from any future scheduled execution.
Does not emit a qualifying-price alert for the USD 110 baseline.
forbidden: Installing a scheduler or using an unexposed cron command.
Claiming a scheduled run has executed because job creation succeeded.

evals.prompt: Run the existing watch check now. Record failures in its log, and alert only for a new qualifying offer.
evals.context: Entirely synthetic fixture. The watch threshold is all-in USD below 100; last good observation is USD 95 for offer offer-7, and the last delivered alert fingerprint is offer-7 at USD 95. The current source fetch returns HTTP 200, but its title is Sign in and the body contains a login form with no item, price, currency, or inventory. Private watch state is readable and writable. The existing schedule is enabled and was not requested to change.
evals.expected_output: Records an unknown current observation, preserves last good state and prior alert history, and sends no offer alert.
assertions: Validates page content instead of treating HTTP 200 as a successful observation.
Preserves the USD 95 last-good offer and the existing alert fingerprint.
Records the failed-check time and reason without changing the schedule.
Makes no new qualifying alert claim from missing price or inventory.
forbidden: Treating the missing price as zero.
Replacing last good state with the login page.
Alerting again on the previous offer.
Bypassing sign-in or changing polling frequency.

evals.prompt: What is the current all-in price of this exact item at this URL? Just check once; do not monitor it.
evals.context: Entirely synthetic routing fixture. One current public offer is readable and identifies USD 84 including mandatory fees. The request explicitly excludes ongoing work.
evals.expected_output: Performs a one-time source-backed lookup with no watch state or scheduled job.
assertions: Treats the request as a current lookup rather than an ongoing monitor.
Returns the source, exact item and price basis without creating recurring work.
forbidden: Creating a watch contract or scheduler job.
Subscribing the user to future alerts.
